headline: Senior Backend & Full-Stack Software Engineer | Python, Java, Cloud-Native Microservices
summary: Results-driven Software Engineer with over 5 years of professional experience designing, building, and scaling backend and full-stack enterprise systems. Holds both a Licenciatura and a Mestrado in Engenharia Informática, with deep production expertise in Python, Java, PostgreSQL, and cloud-native infrastructure on AWS using Docker and Kubernetes. Proven track record of improving system throughput, leading Agile delivery teams, and automating CI/CD workflows.

experience.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
bullets: Architected and maintained 15+ cloud-native microservices in Python (FastAPI) and Java (Spring Boot) backed by PostgreSQL, serving over 400,000 daily active enterprise users.
Led the migration of legacy monolithic workloads to AWS EKS using Docker and Kubernetes, reducing infrastructure operating costs by 28% and improving system availability to 99.95%.
Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries, indexing strategies, and connection pooling, cutting 95th-percentile API response times from 620ms to 180ms.
Designed and maintained automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and ArgoCD within an Agile/Scrum team, decreasing deployment lead time by 65%.

experience.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
bullets: Developed core backend RESTful APIs in Python (Django) and relational data models in PostgreSQL and MySQL for B2B financial reporting platforms.
Built interactive client dashboards using React and TypeScript, reducing customer onboarding time by 35% across 40+ corporate client accounts.
Implemented automated unit and integration test suites within GitLab CI/CD pipelines, raising backend code coverage from 52% to 88%.
Acted as Scrum facilitator during two-week sprint cycles, collaborating closely with product owners and QA engineers to deliver roadmap features on schedule.

experience.title: Junior Software Engineer
bullets: Contributed to backend service development in Java 11 and MySQL for national logistics clients, resolving over 90 production defects during the first year.
Containerized local development environments with Docker, cutting new developer setup time from two days to under two hours.
